sources.title: LoKr · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Low-Rank Kronecker Product (LoKr), is a LoRA-variant method that approximates the large weight matrix with two low-rank matrices and combines them with the Kronecker product. LoKr also provides an optional third low-rank matrix to provide better control during fine-tuning.
